title: Beyond Compressing Everything: Contrastive Memory Learning for Selective Context Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.16384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) advance toward increasingly long inputs, soft context compression offers a promising approach to efficient inference by converting long inputs into compact memory slots. Under limited memory budgets, effective context compression remains challenging because task-relevant evidence varies substantially across queries, ranging from localized evidence to multiple distant spans or information dispersed throughout the full document. Instead of compressing everything indiscriminately, we propose CoMem, a query-guided selective context compression framework that learns memory representations conditioned on both the document and the query. CoMem develops Contrastive Compressor Learning to achieve query-sensitive yet context-preserving memory representations. translated_title: 超越压缩一切：面向选择性上下文压缩的对比式记忆学习
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）向越来越长的输入发展，软上下文压缩通过将长输入转换为紧凑的记忆槽，为高效推理提供了一种有前景的方法。在有限的记忆预算下，有效的上下文压缩仍然具有挑战性，因为与任务相关的证据在不同查询之间差异巨大，既可能是局部证据，也可能是多个相距遥远的片段，或是分散于整个文档中的信息。与其不加区分地压缩所有内容，我们提出了CoMem，一个查询引导的选择性上下文压缩框架，它学习同时以文档和查询为条件的记忆表示。CoMem开发了对比式压缩器学习，以实现既对查询敏感又保留上下文信息的记忆表示。为了注入关于查询相关证据分布的强先验，我们设计了一种同上下文难负样本挖掘策略，通过将单个文档与……[原文摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 提出CoMem查询引导选择性上下文压缩框架，通过结合同上下文难负样本挖掘的对比式压缩器学习，获得对查询敏感且保留上下文的记忆表示，从而在有限记忆预算下实现更高效的大语言模型推理。
en_tdlr: CoMem is a query-guided selective context compression framework that leverages Contrastive Compressor Learning with same-context hard negative mining to produce query-sensitive yet context-preserving memory representations, enabling efficient LLM inference under limited memory budgets.
